decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is far from the core offer and shows only a mention on the website, so little public commitment exists, but such defense and maritime projects involve significant certification investment and long contract cycles that make management attribute slow uptake to temporary causes and persist.

The medical examination light has its own page and builds on core lighting competence, and medical certification costs already sunk create strong pressure to persist rather than write off the investment.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires fit the firm's industrial customer base and LED strategy, carry heavy sunk ATEX certification and testing investment, and are visibly presented, so dropping them is very unlikely.

The designer task light is a publicly announced relaunch of a popular product, close to the established offer, so management has committed itself visibly and would keep it to justify the relaunch decision.
